input_level: RMS at primary terminals; un-loaded sinusoidal source calibrated per operating point
target_intervals: Own visual readout intervals and published specifications, not original measurement arrays
subaudio_amplitude_curve: Measurement level unspecified. Used for linear-background fit only; not asserted to be the large-signal model at +4dBu or infinitesimal virgin-stop response
validation: 30 Hz level curve, +14 dBu frequency curve and selected amplitude/phase points held out
digital_mapping: 1 kHz sine at -18 dBFS peak -> +4 dBu RMS primary; one fixed mapping for every profile
gain_policy: Export raw loss and explicit fixed small-signal normalization; no level-dependent auto-makeup
